description: Delete one note from the office memory. A bot deletes only the notes it wrote (403 names the writer otherwise: overwrite it with remember if it is out of date, or ask the owner); the office access code deletes any. 404 when there is no such key. Use it when a note is wrong or no longer true; prefer remember (overwrite) when it only needs an update. Same as DELETE /v1/in/memory/:key.

agent_id.description: Only on a link that is not bound to one bot: which bot is deleting.

name: forget
title: Forget a note
